verses.translation: For David, a Psalm of Jeremias. By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat; and wept when we remembered Sion.

translations.ron: La râul Babilonului, acolo am şezut şi am plâns, când ne-am adus aminte de Sion.
translations.grk: Τῷ Δαυὶδ, Ἱερεμίου. Ἐπὶ τῶν ποταμῶν Βαβυλῶνος ἐκεῖ ἐκαθίσαμεν, καὶ ἐκλαύσαμεν ἐν τῷ μνησθῆναι ἡμᾶς τῆς Σιών.

verses.translation: We hung our harps on the willows in the midst of it.

translations.ron: În sălcii, în mijlocul lor, am atârnat harpele noastre.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ ταῖς ἰτέαις ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐκρεμάσαμεν τὰ ὄργανα ἡμῶν.

verses.translation: For there they that had taken us captive asked of us the words of a song; and they that had carried us away asked a hymn, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Sion.

translations.ron: Că acolo cei ce ne-au robit pe noi ne-au cerut nouă cântare, zicând: "Cântaţi-ne nouă din cântările Sionului!"
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐπηρώτησαν ἡμᾶς οἱ αἰχμαλωτεύσαντες ἡμᾶς, λόγους ᾠδῶν, καὶ οἱ ἀπαγαγόντες ἡμᾶς, ὕμνον· ᾄσατε ἡμῖν ἐκ τῶν ᾠδῶν Σιών.

verses.translation: How should we sing the Lord's song in a strange land?

translations.ron: Cum să cântăm cântarea Domnului în pământ străin?
translations.grk: Πῶς ᾄσωμεν τὴν ᾠδὴν Κυρίου ἐπὶ γῆς ἀλλοτρίας;

verses.translation: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

translations.ron: De te voi uita, Ierusalime, uitată să fie dreapta mea!
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ἐπιλάθωμαί σου Ἱερουσαλήμ, ἐπιλησθείη ἡ δεξιά μου.

verses.translation: May my tongue cleave to my throat, if I do not remember thee; if I do not prefer Jerusalem as the chief of my joy.

translations.ron: Să se lipească limba mea de grumazul meu, de nu-mi voi aduce aminte de tine, de nu voi pune înainte Ierusalimul, ca început al bucuriei mele.
translations.grk: Κολληθείη ἡ γλῶσσά μου τῷ λάρυγγί μου, ἐὰν μή σου μνησθῷ· ἐὰν μὴ προανατάξωμαι τὴν Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἐν ἀρχῇ τῆς εὐφροσύνης μου.

verses.translation: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to its foundations.

translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte, Doamne, de fiii lui Edom, în ziua dărâmării Ierusalimului, când ziceau: "Stricaţi-l, stricaţi-l până la temeliile lui!"
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, τῶν υἱῶν Ἐδὼμ τὴν ἡμέραν Ἱερουσαλήμ· τῶν λεγόντων, ἐκκενοῦτε ἐκκενοῦτε, ἕως τῶν θεμελίων αὐτῇς.

verses.translation: Wretched daughter of Babylon! blessed shall he be who shall reward thee as thou hast rewarded us.

translations.ron: Fiica Babilonului, ticăloasa! Fericit este cel ce-ţi va răsplăti ţie fapta ta pe care ai făcut-o nouă.
translations.grk: Θυγάτηρ Βαβυλῶνος ἡ ταλαίπωρος, μακάριος ὃς ἀνταποδώσει σοι τὸ ἀνταπόδομά σου, ὃ ἀνταπέδωκας ἡμῖν.

verses.translation: Blessed shall he be who shall seize and dash thine infants against the rock.

translations.ron: Fericit este cel ce va apuca şi va lovi pruncii tăi de piatră.
translations.grk: Μακάριος ὃς κρατήσει καὶ ἐδαφιεῖ τὰ νήπιά σου πρὸς τὴν πέτραν.
